title: Measuring Human Adaptation to AI in Decision Making: Application to Evaluate Changes after AlphaGo
reasoning: The paper dedicates one of its two main studies (Adaptation II: Cheating from AI) to detecting and analyzing cheating, which is an ethical issue. This study uses the proposed 'Human-AI Gap' measure to identify a real-world instance where a professional player cheated by using an AI program. This focus on unfair competitive advantage and fair play constitutes a core part of the paper's investigation, not merely a peripheral ethical consideration.
